court: In the High Court of Madras†
respondents: Regional Joint Registrar of Co-operative Societies and Others
advocates: For Respondents : Mr. S. Shaji Bino Special Government Pleader
prayer: Prayer: Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, to issue a writ of certiorarified mandamus calling for the records pertaining to the order of suspension issued by the third respondent dated 18-12-2025 and quash the same and consequently directing the respondents to permit the petitioner to continue in service as General Manager in the third respondent Society.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

Mummineni Sudheer Kumar, J.:— This writ petition has been filed challenging the order dated 18-12-2025, issued by the third respondent, placing the petitioner under suspension.

2. Today, when the matter is taken up for consideration for admission, learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the impugned suspension order has been revoked by the third respondent through proceedings dated 25-3-2026.

3. In the light of the above submission, the relief sought in this writ petition has now become infructuous.

4. Accordingly, this writ petition is closed as having become infructuous. No costs. Consequently, connected miscellaneous petitions are closed.
